<?php
class Base160Review {
    public int $value = 10;
    public function __clone() { echo "base|"; $this->value += 2; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "drop", $this->value, "|"; }
}
$replacement160Review = new class {};
$source160Review = new class extends Base160Review {
    public function __clone() {
        global $source160Review, $replacement160Review;
        echo "child|";
        parent::__clone();
        $source160Review = $replacement160Review;
        echo "after-rebind|";
    }
};
$copy160Review = clone $source160Review;
echo "observed|", $copy160Review->value, "|";
unset($copy160Review);
echo "after";

<?php
$escaped160Review = null;
$given160Review = new Exception("clone");
$destination160Review = 99;
$source160Review = new class {
    public int $value = 7;
    public function __clone() {
        global $escaped160Review, $given160Review;
        $escaped160Review = $this;
        echo "clone|";
        throw $given160Review;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "drop", $this->value, "|"; }
};
try {
    $destination160Review = clone $source160Review;
} catch (Exception $caught160Review) {
    echo $caught160Review === $given160Review ? "same|" : "wrong-exception|";
}
echo $destination160Review, "|";
echo $escaped160Review === $source160Review ? "bad|" : "fresh|";
echo $escaped160Review->value, "|manual-before|";
$escaped160Review->__destruct();
echo "manual-after|";
unset($escaped160Review);
echo "source-before|";
unset($source160Review);
echo "after";

<?php
$shared160Author = 4;
$source160Author = new class {
    public array $items;
    public int $mark = 1;
    public function __clone(): void {
        echo $this->items[0], "|", $this->mark, "|";
        $this->items[0] = 11;
        $this->items[1] += 3;
        $this->mark = 8;
    }
};
$source160Author->items = [2, &$shared160Author];
$copy160Author = clone $source160Author;
echo $source160Author->items[0], "|", $copy160Author->items[0], "|", $shared160Author, "|";
echo $source160Author->items[1], "|", $copy160Author->items[1], "|";
echo $source160Author->mark, "|", $copy160Author->mark, "|";
echo $source160Author === $copy160Author ? "bad|" : "distinct|";
echo "after";

<?php
class ClonePayload160Author {
    public int $value = 5;
    public function __destruct() { echo "payload", $this->value, "|"; }
}
$payload160Author = new ClonePayload160Author;
$source160Author = new class {
    public $child;
    public int $tag = 1;
    public function __clone(): void {
        echo $this->child->value, "|";
        $this->child->value = 9;
        $this->child = new ClonePayload160Author;
        $this->child->value = 14;
        $this->tag = 2;
    }
};
$source160Author->child = $payload160Author;
$copy160Author = clone $source160Author;
echo $source160Author->child === $payload160Author ? "shared|" : "bad|";
echo $source160Author->child === $copy160Author->child ? "bad|" : "replaced|";
echo $source160Author->child->value, "|", $copy160Author->child->value, "|";
echo $source160Author->tag, "|", $copy160Author->tag, "|";
unset($payload160Author);
unset($source160Author);
echo "between|";
unset($copy160Author);
echo "after";

<?php
$sourceText160Author = 'namespace Clone160Author;
function make160Author() {
    return new class {
        public int $mark = 1;
        function __clone() {
            $this->mark += 2;
            return "body-return";
        }
    };
}';
eval($sourceText160Author);
$first160Author = Clone160Author\make160Author();
$second160Author = Clone160Author\make160Author();
$copy160Author = clone $first160Author;
echo $first160Author->mark, "|", $copy160Author->mark, "|";
echo $copy160Author === $first160Author ? "bad|" : "fresh|";
echo $first160Author === $second160Author ? "bad|" : "separate|";
$explicit160Author = $second160Author->__clone();
echo $explicit160Author, "|", $second160Author->mark, "|", $first160Author->mark, "|after";

<?php
echo "before|";
$receiver160Author = new class {
    public function __CLONE(): int {
        echo "bad-body|";
        return 1;
    }
};
echo "after";
